    SELECT DISTINCT
        words,
        LENGTH(words) as len,
        pos,
        SUBSTR(words, pos, 1) as letter
    FROM word_list
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(1, LENGTH(words))) as t(pos)
),
letter_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        words,
        len,
        SUM(CASE WHEN letter = 'a' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cnt_a,
        SUM(CASE WHEN letter = 'b' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cnt_b,
        SUM(CASE WHEN letter = 'c' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cnt_c,
        SUM(CASE WHEN letter = 'd' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as cnt_d
    FROM word_letters
    GROUP BY words, len
),
word_sigs AS (
    SELECT 
        words,
        len,
        cnt_a || cnt_b || cnt_c || cnt_d as partial_sig
    FROM letter_counts
    WHERE len IN (4, 5)
    AND SUBSTR(words, 1, 1) = 'r'
    AND cnt_a = 2 AND cnt_d = 1
)
